schema.name: alignment_suggestions
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE `alignment_suggestions` (
  `id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  `hymn_id` text NOT NULL,
  `section` text NOT NULL,
  `source_url` text NOT NULL,
  `status` text DEFAULT 'queued' NOT NULL,
  `payload_json` text DEFAULT '{}' NOT NULL,
  `version` integer DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` integer NOT NULL
)

schema.name: error_report_limits
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE error_report_limits (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, window INTEGER NOT NULL, count INTEGER NOT NULL)

schema.name: error_reports
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE error_reports (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, hymn_id TEXT NOT NULL, title TEXT NOT NULL, section TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, position INTEGER NOT NULL, excerpt TEXT NOT NULL, message TEXT NOT NULL, reporter TEXT NOT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open')

schema.name: hazzat_score_active
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE hazzat_score_active (
    hymn_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
    score_version TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL
  )

schema.name: hazzat_score_pages
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE hazzat_score_pages (
    hymn_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    score_version TEXT NOT NULL,
    page_index INTEGER NOT NULL,
    object_key TEXT NOT NULL,
    lines_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (hymn_id,score_version,page_index)
  )

schema.name: hymn_library_presentation
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE hymn_library_presentation (
  hymn_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  title TEXT,
  folder_order INTEGER,
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL
)

schema.name: hymn_library_state
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE hymn_library_state (
    hymn_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
    sort_order INTEGER,
    is_removed INTEGER DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
    updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL
  )

schema.name: hymn_projects
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE `hymn_projects` (
	`hymn_id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`title` text NOT NULL,
	`season` text NOT NULL,
	`service` text NOT NULL,
	`owner_email` text NOT NULL,
	`status` text DEFAULT 'draft' NOT NULL,
	`timings_json` text DEFAULT '[]' NOT NULL,
	`hazzat_timings_json` text DEFAULT '[]' NOT NULL,
	`hazzat_line_timings_json` text DEFAULT '[]' NOT NULL,
	`recording_url` text,
	`recording_key` text,
	`notation_html` text,
	`notation_key` text,
	`updated_at` integer NOT NULL,
	`completed_at` integer
, `text_content` text, `coptic_text` text, `coptic_timings_json` text DEFAULT '[]' NOT NULL, `english_recording_url` text, `english_recording_key` text, `coptic_recording_url` text, `coptic_recording_key` text)

schema.name: hymn_recording_clips
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE hymn_recording_clips (
    hymn_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    section TEXT NOT NULL,
    clip_start REAL NOT NULL,
    clip_end REAL NOT NULL,
    updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (hymn_id,section)
  )

schema.name: hymn_repeat_sections
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE hymn_repeat_sections (hymn_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, sections_json TEXT NOT NULL)

schema.name: hymn_title_inheritance
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE hymn_title_inheritance (
    target_hymn_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,

    title_key TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL
  )

schema.name: library_nodes
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE library_nodes (
    node_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
    node_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    season_id TEXT,
    category_id TEXT,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    owner_email TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT DEFAULT 'draft' NOT NULL,
    updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL
  )

schema.name: reference_alignment_drafts
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE `reference_alignment_drafts` (
  `id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  `hymn_id` text NOT NULL,
  `section` text NOT NULL,
  `payload_json` text DEFAULT '{}' NOT NULL,
  `revision` integer DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  `status` text DEFAULT 'review' NOT NULL,
  `created_at` integer NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` integer NOT NULL
)
